business_summary: Indo Thai Securities Limited engages in the stock and share broking, depository participants, and other related ancillary businesses in India. The company operates through Equity, F&O, Currency Derivatives, Mutual Fund, Income from Depository Operations, and Commodity segments. It is involved in the trading of equity broking, commodity broking, currency broking, algorithmic trading, institutional desk services, research and advisory services, depository participant (DP) services, IEPF services, wealth management, family office services, mutual fund distribution, AIF Category 2 services, investment banking, capital raising, strategic advisory, and international financial gateway services. It serves corporate clients, high net worth individuals, mega traders, and retail investors. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Indore, India.
